title: Leveraging Dependency Grammar for Fine-Grained Offensive Language Detection using Graph Convolutional Networks

bias_targets.target: Systemic lexical bias (Identity term and dialect bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating overall classification performance (Precision, Recall, F1-score) on fine-grained hate speech and offensive language datasets to demonstrate that incorporating syntactic features reduces the model's tendency to over-generalize toxicity scores to innocuous statements containing specific identity terms, minority dialects (e.g., African-American English), or general profanities.

primary_bias_target: Systemic lexical bias (Identity term and dialect bias)
